items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Now they mugging and I played with all of them. Sam, Isaiah, Andrew, all of them.

ctx.x: It sounded great the night I heard him. He just played one or two tunes right. He's been drinking bad wine and everything, you know. Uh-uh. But he played Royal Garden Blues and Sister Kate and they really sounded good. That's right. He had his lip and everything. Oh Lord. They tell me he could get up above the staff and listen. Yeah, sure right too.
Rene was a nice trumpet player. Uh-huh. Boy looked like old Mexican and he was a nice trumpet player. Rene. Now they mugging and I played with all of them. Sam, Isaiah, Andrew, all of them.
When did you work with Sam?
